notes: The single written the of the great sea stands before great, so by rule 47's test it goes to the adjective's article and the article on yam is unrepresented; JOS.15.47 is aligned the same way.
s005 keeps the supplied was on the predicate noun rather than on the directive he, since rule 49 wants a preposition and none is present; the unit note records the competing reading.
t013 thereof is italic and answers to no morpheme, גְבוּל carrying no suffix (rules 7, 30).
